definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone that arouses suspicion or doubt. Often used in the context of suspicious behavior, unidentified persons, or doubtful circumstances.

examples.japanese: {不審|ふしん}な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
{不審|ふしん}な⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駅員|えきいん}→駅員：05503_ekiin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}らせて→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you see a suspicious package, please notify station staff immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不審|ふしん}な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さらに⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: There were many questionable points in his explanation, and the police decided to investigate further.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a modifier before nouns: {不審|ふしん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧, {不審|ふしん}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧, {不審|ふしん}な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧. Very common in police reports, news, and public safety announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不審|ふしん}{者|しゃ} (suspicious person)
- {不審|ふしん}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (suspicious behavior)
- {不審|ふしん}な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (questionable point)
- {不審|ふしん}{物|ぶつ} (suspicious object)
- {不審|ふしん}{死|し} (suspicious death)
- {不審|ふしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to find something suspicious)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{不振|ふしん}→不振：07771_fushin⟧: slump, poor performance — same reading, completely different meaning (e.g., {営業不振|えいぎょうふしん} "business slump")
- ⟦{不信|ふしん}→不信：18313_fushin⟧: distrust, disbelief — also same reading, different kanji (e.g., {政治不信|せいじふしん} "political distrust")
